Traffic.description: Total unique visitors to the platform.

Conversion_Rate.description: Percentage of visitors who make a purchase.

business_rules: A Traffic drop with a stable Conversion_Rate implies a top-of-funnel issue (e.g., marketing budget cut, SEO penalty).
A Conversion_Rate drop with stable Traffic implies a bottom-of-funnel or product issue (e.g., broken checkout, out of stock, price error).
If Revenue drops significantly but Traffic and Conversion_Rate are stable, the Average_Order_Value (AOV) must have dropped, likely due to deep discounting or mix shift.
